title: Raster React Parity
description: Get raster to premigration level (git tag `premigration`, where raster/react/index.tsx was an 872-line react renderer around the Rust/WASM WebGPU compositor RasterSession — RasterCanvas/RasterLayerView/RasterMaskView, 4 view modes, wheel zoom-to-cursor, middle-button pan, marquee/lasso/wand selection with modifier merge, stacked-pick disambiguation menu, hover/selection chrome, brush/eraser painting, theme-synced checkerboard) for the react renderer on the migrated Rust plugin architecture: raster/plugin/rs emits UiTree interpreted by framework/renderer/react, currently rendering only a static flat PNG via the raster-host.tsx stub. Follow the approach of PUZZLE-2D-REACT-PARITY, PUZZLE-3D-REACT-PARITY and PUZZLE-5D-REACT-PARITY (26/07/09, 26/07/09, 26/07/10).
summary: Restored premigration React-renderer parity for both trinity apps. Jack: wired the editor to real textEdit/textSelect/requestCompletions/formatDocument/submit commands with live tokens/diagnostics/completions/occurrences (trinity_jack semantic_tokens/lint/complete), added 6-tier LOD (WindowMeasure select + lod_json) on the graph window, restored History/Query toolbars via tools(), render graph-kind Jack query results as an actual node-graph instead of a table, restored all 8 example queries, added a Geometry inspector group (flatPosition u/v), and fixed a latent bug where undo/redo silently no-opped because `applied_edit_ids` was never persisted/restored across command dispatches. Rewrite: replaced the ad-hoc JSON snapshot undo stack with a proper VCS-backed RewriteRuleState/RewriteRuleOp (whole-state LWW operation) in trinity_rewrite, wired undo/redo/commitCheckpoint through it, made LHS/RHS rule graphs editable (drag persists rule_layout, delete removes the matching clause, catalogue "Add to LHS/RHS" entries), restored Jack-view occurrence cross-highlighting and syntax tokens, fixed SurfaceKind honesty (NodeGraph/TextEditor instead of blanket Canvas2d), added History/Reorganize toolbars and LOD selects, made the inspector Name field editable, and deleted ~90 lines of dead command arms (setLhsGraphHover/setRhsGraphHover/setLhsGraphSelect/setRhsGraphSelect/setJackSelect/setJackHover and a duplicate setJackSelect arm) that the React host never actually dispatched, replacing them with surface-routed generic handlers. Also fixed a real framework bug (text-editor-host.tsx onPointerUp referencing an out-of-scope `rect`) and added a shared `text_identifier_bounds_at`/`text_identifier_occurrences_json` helper to framework/core, refactoring writer-plugin to use it instead of its own (subtly buggy) copy. Added trinity-jack-react-dev / trinity-rewrite-react-dev to .claude/launch.json. Verified with 24 new/updated Rust unit tests (all passing) covering rendering, commands, VCS undo/redo across separate dispatches, LOD, tools, editor services, and clause add/delete. Live browser verification was blocked by a shared-registry race (many concurrent dev sessions overwriting framework/plugin/registry/generated/plugins.ts with their own plugin filter every few seconds) — not a code issue, just contention in this multi-agent dev environment.
